title: feat(toolbar): extend list, blockquote and heading toggle to multi-line selections

commits.message:
feat(toolbar): extend list, blockquote and heading toggle to multi-line selections

Previously toggleOrderedList, toggleUnorderedList, toggleBlockquote, and
toggleHeading only operated on the single line containing the anchor
position, ignoring the selection end (head). This meant clicking a toolbar
button while multiple lines were selected silently transformed just one line.

This change extends all four functions to act on every line covered by the
current selection:

- toggleUnorderedList / toggleOrderedList: if all selected lines are already
  in the target list format the markers are removed (toggle off); otherwise
  every line receives the marker. Ordered lists re-number from 1. Existing
  markers of the opposite type are replaced rather than stacked.
- toggleBlockquote: same toggle-off-when-all semantics; in the mixed case
  only lines that are not yet blockquotes receive "> ".
- toggleHeading: toggles off when every selected line is already at the
  requested level; upgrades or adds the heading prefix otherwise.

All four functions degrade gracefully to the previous single-line behaviour
when anchor === head (no selection).

Adds 22 new test cases covering: apply-to-all, toggle-off, mixed state,
cross-type conversion (ol↔ul), indented nested lists, and single-line
fallback.

Roadmap: P1 · Item #1
